traits.name: Desert-Adapted
traits.text: A camel is well-adapted to heat and deserts. If allowed to drink and eat its fill, (roughly 40 gallons), it can Subsist for 2 weeks without needing to attempt Survival checks, and it treats environmental heat as if it was one step less severe.

traits.name: Camel Spit
traits.text: To drive away enemies, the camel spits the partially digested contents of its stomach at a creature within 10 feet. On a hit, the target is dazzled for 1 round and must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save or become sickened 1. The camel can't use its camel spit Strike again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Sand Stride
traits.text: ⬺ The camel Strides twice. It has a +5-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed during these Strides, ignoring difficult terrain caused by rubble, sand, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.
